control.objective: Test whether 4h trade intensity works as a FILTER on the existing long-only strategy: skip entries whose 4h trade-intensity percentile (trades vs the trailing 20-bar average) is above a threshold. Sweep thresholds (no filter / p90 / p75 / p50), report trades kept, net R/t with 95% CI, and gross R/t, split by regime (2023, 2024, 2025-26, ALL). The signal to test is NEGATIVE: high intensity predicted LOWER forward returns (non-overlapping IC -0.160, z=-1.90), so the filter should REMOVE high-intensity entries.
control.notes:
ARCHITECT DESIGN (follow this; do not restructure):

1) New standalone file intensityfilter.mjs. Do NOT modify backtest.js, strategy.js or any frozen path -- compute the filter OUTSIDE the backtester and apply it to the returned trade list is NOT possible (results are bare R numbers), so instead pre-compute intensity per entry timestamp and pass a `skipBefore` style guard by running the backtest per-pair and correlating. If that proves impossible without touching backtest.js, set BLOCKED and say so rather than editing a frozen file.

2) Import loadCandles from data.js, loadBars from data.js (1m bars carry the `trades` column), backtestMultiTF from backtest.js, and the shared helpers from researchlib.mjs (loadWatchlist, ts, stat). Reuse them; do not re-implement stats.

3) IMPORTANT DATA CONSTRAINT: only BTC/ETH/SOL have order-flow (`trades`) data, and only for 2026. The archive-ingested bars have trades=0. So this test is limited to those three pairs over the flow window -- state that limitation in the output rather than silently averaging in pairs with no data.

4) Honesty requirements: report gross AND net, include 95% CIs via stat(), and print the trade count at each threshold. A filter that improves R/t purely by cutting the sample to a handful of trades is not an improvement -- flag it when n drops below 30.

blackboard.repo_purpose: Long-only spot crypto trading bot (Kraken) + an honest research pipeline. Live trading is OFF by default (LIVE_TRADING=true to enable) and must stay off: the strategy measures net-negative.
blackboard.known_findings: See ROADMAP.md. Settled with real numbers, do NOT re-test: the swing entry is statistically indistinguishable from random (8,203 trades); gross-of-cost expectancy ~0 so cheaper fills cannot rescue it; exit-model and stop-placement sweeps both negative; the simple daily strategy is beta not alpha (indistinguishable from random entries passing the same MA20 gate).
blackboard.live_signal: 4h trade intensity is the ONE surviving candidate: non-overlapping IC -0.160 (z=-1.90, CI [-0.325,+0.005]) over 48h horizons. Not significant, but it strengthened rather than collapsed when overlap was removed. Direction: busy 4h bars precede LOWER 48h returns.
